annotations.title: Zoek events bij The List Access

description: Search upcoming and ongoing public The List Access events without opening the website. Combine event/artist/organizer text, city, genre, venue and inclusive dates in Europe/Amsterdam. Returns details, canonical links, source uncertainty and pagination. Date ranges include overnight events overlapping the selected days. Use from/to for dates; no purchases or guestlist registration.

city.description: City name, for example Amsterdam or Utrecht. Filters events to that city; omit for all cities.

genre.description: Music genre, for example House or Techno. Matches published genre labels using the calendar genre aliases; omit for all genres.

guestlist.description: True selects listed guestlist actions; admission is never confirmed by this search.

limit.description: Maximum number of events per result page, from 1 to 20; defaults to 10. Keep the same limit when requesting subsequent pages.

page.description: Result page, starting at 1 (default). Use nextPage from the previous response with the same filters and limit; pages beyond available results return an error.

q.description: Event, artist or organizer search text. All terms must match.

venue.description: Venue name, for example Paradiso. Matches the calendar venue identity; combine with city to distinguish venues with the same name.

name: search_events
title: Doorzoek The List Access-evenementen
